changelog.entry: New: a Copy result button under the Archive copies a one-line result (how much of the set's archive you found, and your achievements) to share. Earned achievements now have a Share button, and a Credits link sits at the bottom of the page.

Three more ways to play. Whose account? sets short summaries of real sources side by side, such as Lincoln's own words, a letter written the next day and a park page, and asks who wrote each, what they could see, what they wanted and what they left out. Decision points show a choice someone really faced, let you pick, then show what they chose and what followed. Review brings back what you have learned after gaps of 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days; days only move when you press Let a day pass, and nothing is lost while you are away. Eight new achievements, and the Info page and archive cover all three.

Two new ways to play. Cause web: pick the earlier moment, then the one it led to, and the game confirms only the links the sources support and says how strong the evidence is, because causes are plural. Myth or record: sort statements as documented, disputed or doubtful and read why from the sources. Both fill the archive and bring seven new achievements. The Info page now shows cause links, a strength legend and which claims you have not met yet.

Chronicle begins as a sample: order moments from the American presidency on a timeline, and watch the archive fill in. Every fact names three sources, and you can flag a claim that looks wrong. The set is a draft until it has been reviewed.
